close_reason: Fixed in 911334131: BuildMacroExecutable now drives/completes the macro BackendProgram product directly instead of scheduling BuildBackendProduct, and the macro test asserts the backend-backed macro executable telemetry rather than the old separate job shape.
description:
Goal
Remove the remaining push-shaped macro backend readiness handoff: BuildMacroExecutable must not wait on BackendProgram(macro_root) by scheduling BuildBackendProduct(macro_root).

Signal
fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz with --log-telemetry interp has BuildBackendProduct=0, SealSemanticClosure=0, DeriveTransportPlan=0, DeriveRuntimeDemand=0, and DeriveExecutableTransport=0. Macro executable tests still prove the macro runtime is backed by a BackendProgram revision/inventory, not a separate evaluator.

Strategy
When a macro backend fact is missing, BuildMacroExecutable may drive the product backend directly and complete the BackendProgram fact without adding a follow_up producer job. Update tests that pinned the old visible BuildBackendProduct job shape to assert the backend-backed macro executable artifact instead.

Verification
compiler2 macro test, port macro tests, compiler2_pull_, 00181 telemetry, cargo fmt/check/clippy.
title: Macro executable readiness should not self-schedule backend products
